name: Zain
source:
Faction: NPC
Race: Human
Occupation: Merchant
Reality: None
Hobby: Listening to people’s stories
Specialty: Server data analysis
Favorite Food: Pot-au-feu (extra vegetables)
Dislikes: Lemons

"I'm the only one who gets to look at you..."

A silver-haired young man who was found unconscious in the woods. All of his memories had disappeared, except for his feeling of responsibility to protect Kazuha, and he does precisely that.

Originally, he was a NPC who guided people around town and provided players with quests. Upon finding out about his true self through meeting Kazuha, he begins to explore his pure and gentle, but somewhat deviant side.

The fact he actually doesn’t exist starts to frustrate him, and his vulnerability begins to rear its head as a result. 

[From the [url=http://aksysgames.com/pcube/]official site[/url]]
